partners.mechanism_chain: GJA1 (HGNC:4274) —DISRUPTS→ Keratinocyte dysfunction (HP:0030031); Keratinocyte dysfunction (HP:0030031) —LEADS_TO→ Abnormal skin morphology (HP:0000972); GJA1 (HGNC:4274) —DISRUPTS→ Abnormal dentition (HP:0000160); GJA1 (HGNC:4274) —DISRUPTS→ Abnormal limb morphology (HP:0002671); GJA1 (HGNC:4274) —DISRUPTS→ Abnormal ocular morphology (HP:0000477). Mutations in GJA1 lead to haploinsufficiency, disrupting connexin-43 function. This dysfunction affects keratinocyte proliferation and differentiation, contributing to palmoplantar keratoderma and alopecia (Disease A). Simultaneously, the disruption in connexin-43 mediated cell-cell communication impacts craniofacial development, leading to abnormal dentition, limbs, and ocular structures characteristic of oculodentodigital dysplasia (Disease B).

partners.mechanism_chain: GJA1 (HGNC:4072) —DISRUPTS→ Gap Junction Formation and Function (GO:0005874); GJB1 (HGNC:4076) —DISRUPTS→ Gap Junction Formation and Function (GO:0005874); Gap Junction Formation and Function (GO:0005874) —LEADS_TO→ Palmoplantar Keratoderma (HP:0000970); Gap Junction Formation and Function (GO:0005874) —LEADS_TO→ Congenital Alopecia (HP:0001003); Gap Junction Formation and Function (GO:0005874) —LEADS_TO→ Charcot-Marie-Tooth disease (HP:0003198).
